250-779-1479-5412-8337.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-8337.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5412-8337.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

618-1916-3899.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

539-1462-3821-4679-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-6495.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat

116-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-6871-6879-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-6871-6879-8095.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5268-6248--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5268-6248--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4478-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4478-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4478-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

1722-2034-4365-4893-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-4365-4893-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1257-3259-5233--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-3259-5233--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2558-6705-6737-6798.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1563-2457-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

582-1409-4772.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2757-3713-4311-5078.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

109-232-1235-5913.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4050-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2719-4013-7009.manaNeeded: {2}{C} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2719-4013-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

3532-5078-5645-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1778-4779-5220-6900.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3858-6864.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Chameleon Colossus by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power.
Repeat step 2 until Chameleon Colossus has power 20 or greater.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
3858-6864.notes: The mana prerequisite assumes Chameleon Colossus has 4 power when executing the combo. If it has more power, the mana cost will be reduced accordingly.

2034-3562-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1947-2486-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-2486-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

394-856-4050-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-2292-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-2292-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

245-1069-4068-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-4068-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

64-2061-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
64-2061-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

509-1267-3263-3933.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-3263-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3263-3933.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2292-5370-5434.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2875-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Azra Smokeshaper does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
2875-3489-3542.description:
Declare Azra Smokeshaper as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Azra Smokeshaper from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Azra Smokeshaper's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Azra Smokeshaper onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

500-2557-3035-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nadier.
500-2557-3035-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least seven +1/+1 counters on Nadier, and the remaining nine +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nadier, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1309-1987-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1309-1987-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Great Whale.
When Salvager of Secrets and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

1409-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
You control at least two additional Spirits.
1409-2440-3263.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {2}, blinking it.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

914-1354-2635-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1354-2635-4702.description:
Activate Dockside Extortionist by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving the nontoken Dockside Extortionist +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping the nontoken Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.

708-736-2459-4050.notablePrerequisites: Copy Enchantment is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-736-2459-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

618-1125-5200-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least five additional creatures.
618-1125-5200-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Conclave Phalanx with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1578-2713-3096-4621.description:
Cast Manamorphose by paying {1}{R/G}.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Guildmage by paying {U}, copying Manamorphose.
Resolve the Manamorphose copy, adding {1}{U} and drawing a card.
If Jace is on the battlefield, repeat from step 2 until you draw from an empty library, winning the game.
Otherwise, repeat from step 2 until you have one card left in your library.
Resolve the original Manamorphose, adding {U}{U} and drawing a card.
Cast Jace from your hand by paying {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability, causing you to draw from an empty library and win the game.

3545-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3545-4050-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on that Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Sigil Captain triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on that Saproling.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling token, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

386-790-1972.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
386-790-1972.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Nekusar triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters
